decisions.reason: It sits squarely in the firm's core cloud messaging capabilities, was prominent on the home page, and the firm's own R&D and growing market give it strong scope to refine and scale it.

Although a bit broader than pure messaging, it still fits digital document workflows the firm already serves, and having its own page suggests enough strategic commitment to keep learning and improving it.

This service builds directly on the firm's established multichannel communication know-how, so absorptive capacity is high even if the lighter website presence suggests a somewhat more cautious commitment.
As a close extension of the existing fax business, it uses highly related knowledge and should be retained as an incremental optimization feature within the firm's established offer.
Threat protection complements the firm's secure messaging position, and its in-house R&D should help the firm interpret early results and strengthen the offering rather than withdraw it quickly.
Multi-engine virus scanning is closely adjacent to the firm's secure email competencies, so management would likely keep it on the market and improve it through accumulated technical learning.
